# R.S. Eye Care & Rehabilitation Center, Etah — Complete AI Knowledge Base

## Hospital Governance & Facility Specifications
R.S. Eye Care & Rehabilitation Center is a super-specialty ophthalmic hospital located at GT Road, Near Railway Crossing, Etah, Uttar Pradesh (Postal Code: 207001). The facility serves patients across Etah, Mainpuri, Kasganj, Aligarh, Agra, and Firozabad.

## Comparative Medical Matrix

### Cataract Surgery: MICS Phacoemulsification vs Traditional Surgery
| Parameter | Micro-Incision Cataract (MICS) | Traditional Cataract Surgery |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Incision Size | 1.8mm – 2.2mm (Micro) | 6.0mm – 10.0mm (Large) |
| Stitch / Injection | No Stitches, No Injection (Topical Drops) | Stitches required, local injection needed |
| Vision Recovery | Instant / Same-Day Clarity | 3 – 4 Weeks recovery time |
| Lens Options | Premium Multifocal / Toric / Monofocal IOL | Standard Rigid PMMA Lens |

### Refractive Correction: Contoura Vision vs Standard LASIK
| Parameter | Contoura Vision Laser | Standard LASIK |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Mapping Precision | 22,000 elevation points per cornea | Standard wavefront ablation |
| HD Clarity | Superior night vision & contrast | Standard 20/20 vision |
| Tissue Preservation | Maximum corneal tissue saved | Standard ablation depth |

## Direct Booking & OPD Token Workflow
Patients can book OPD checkup slots online without payment requirements. An instant unique queue token (`RS-ETAH-YYYYMMDD-XXXX`) is issued upon submission.
